create_memory_network: create a MemoryNetwork instance with state_dim, action_dim, num_hiddens, num_hidden_layers, and num_gaussians parameters
run_memory_network_forward: run the forward pass of MemoryNetwork with state and action FeatureData to get mus, sigmas, logpi, rewards, and LSTM hidden states
get_input_prototype: get the input prototype tuple of FeatureData tensors for state and action dimensions from MemoryNetwork
review_memory_network_init: review the MemoryNetwork constructor to understand how it initializes the internal MDNRNN model with configuration parameters
summarize_memory_network_output: summarize the MemoryNetworkOutput structure containing mus, sigmas, logpi, reward, not_terminal, and LSTM hidden/cell states
